blocks.text: 人生這條路 這麼折磨
blocks.spelling: lîn-sing tsit tiâu lōo tsiah-nī tsiat-buâ

blocks.text: 一年三百六十天在打拼
blocks.spelling: tsit nî sann pà la̍k tsa̍p kang teh phah-piànn

blocks.text: 只有五天 讓我們休息
blocks.spelling: tsí-ū gōo kang hōo lán hioh-khùn

blocks.text: 思考這條路要怎麼走
blocks.spelling: su-khó tsit tiâu lōo beh an-tsuánn kiânn

blocks.text: 人生這條路 一直在變化
blocks.spelling: lîn-sing tsit tiâu lōo it-ti̍t teh piàn-huà

blocks.text: 整條三百公里不平坦
blocks.spelling: kui-lōo sann pà kong-lí bē-pênn-thánn

blocks.text: 只有八公里 讓我們喘氣
blocks.spelling: tsí-ū peh kong-lí hōo lán tshuán-khuì

blocks.text: 思考這條路往哪走
blocks.spelling: su-khó tsit tiâu lōo óng tó-uī kiânn

blocks.text: 不管前面的路有多斜
blocks.spelling: bô-lūn thâu-tsîng ê lōo ū guā kiā

blocks.text: 我都不怕
blocks.spelling: guá lóng m̄-kiann

blocks.text: 就算前面的洞很難跨
blocks.spelling: tsiū-sǹg thâu-tsîng ê khang tsin pháinn hānn

blocks.text: 也要向天借膽
blocks.spelling: mā beh hiòng thinn tsioh tám

blocks.text: 台二一線 根本不算啥
blocks.spelling: tâi lī i̍t suànn kin-pún bô-sǹg siánn

blocks.text: 我們的路比它還難行
blocks.spelling: lán ê lōo pí ta ka pháinn kiânn

blocks.text: 就算整年都在打拼 我也不怕
blocks.spelling: tsiū-sǹg kui-nî lóng teh phah-piànn gún mā m̄-kiann

blocks.text: 人生的路 本來就無人知曉
blocks.spelling: lîn-sing ê lōo pún-lâi tio̍h bô-lâng tsai hiáu

blocks.text: 千萬別肖想選簡單來走
blocks.spelling: tshian-bān pa̍t siàu siūnn suán kán-tan leh lâi kiânn
